hooks.name: Verify Spec Task Requirements
hooks.description: Verifies completed spec tasks against referenced requirements and runs only related tests.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Look up the requirement IDs it references in the spec's requirements.md, list each acceptance criterion as met / not met with evidence (test name or file:line), and run only the tests related to this task. If anything is not met, say so and stop; do not start the next task.
